FluxFlow.Core.responsibility: Owns the former foundation and exchange source plus the direct application graph. Canonical delivery and typed runtime consolidation remain in progress.

FluxFlow.Json.responsibility: Owns portable documents, declaration parsing, condition compilation and trusted constructor bindings over Core. No Composition/Engine/editor dependency. Direct document resource binding remains to migrate.

FluxFlow.Composition.responsibility: Move address/graph ownership to Core, portable definitions and trusted bindings to Json, fluent builders to Fluent, host resource composition to Engine. Retire the old assembly after consumers migrate.

FluxFlow.Engine.responsibility: Move the sole execution kernel and central instrumentation to Core; retain optional hosting integration here; isolate candidate/swap/rollback in Updates.

FluxFlow.Mapping.responsibility: Optional evaluator-neutral mapping contracts; no implementation dependency from Core.

FluxFlow.Resilience.responsibility: Optional retry and operation policy, reusing Core exchange coordination.

FluxFlow.Fluent.responsibility: Flat authoring over Core; portable-document extensions are optional and do not create a runtime.

FluxFlow.Fluent.Hosting.responsibility: Optional host composition for fluent applications.

FluxFlow.Expressions.CSharp.responsibility: Existing native evaluator integration and host-owned options; compile once.

FluxFlow.Expressions.Jsonata.responsibility: Existing structured-expression integration and bindings; avoid proven redundant conversions.

FluxFlow.Components.Assertions.responsibility: Assertion components with canonical ports and direct construction.

FluxFlow.Components.Assertions.Compositi.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Designer.responsibility: Optional editor projections, metadata and persistence over portable documents; never activate components to inspect schemas.

FluxFlow.Components.Expectations.responsibility: Expectation windows and signals over canonical transport.

FluxFlow.Components.Expectations.Composi.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.FileSystem.responsibility: File operations and watchers with explicit resource ownership and startup.

FluxFlow.Components.FileSystem.Compositi.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Http.responsibility: Request/response components, explicit client dependencies and transport context propagation.

FluxFlow.Components.Http.AspNetCore.responsibility: Optional web host bridge and request lifetime; no dependency from Core.

FluxFlow.Components.Http.Composition.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Mapping.responsibility: Mapping components with evaluator-neutral contracts and canonical ports.

FluxFlow.Components.Mapping.Composition.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Metrics.responsibility: Retain explicitly selected metric-processing components; host metrics export remains outside Core.

FluxFlow.Components.Metrics.Composition.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Mqtt.responsibility: Publish/subscribe components and client contracts; share Core exchange coordination.

FluxFlow.Components.Mqtt.Composition.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Mqtt.MqttNet.responsibility: Existing client provider and its protocol behavior; preserve provider boundary.

FluxFlow.Components.Mqtt.PulseMqtt.responsibility: Existing alternate client provider and its protocol behavior; preserve provider boundary.

FluxFlow.Components.Observability.responsibility: Optional observing components; business delivery independent of slow best-effort observers.

FluxFlow.Components.Observability.Compos.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Payloads.responsibility: Payload components and exact-content boundaries; preserve byte ownership.

FluxFlow.Components.Payloads.Composition.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Projections.responsibility: Projection components and their state semantics with canonical transport.

FluxFlow.Components.Projections.Composit.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.RequestReply.responsibility: Protocol-facing components on the single Core coordinator, not another pending-request implementation.

FluxFlow.Components.Resilience.responsibility: Optional retry/resilience components with explicit attempt identity and canonical ports.

FluxFlow.Components.Resilience.Compositi.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Routing.responsibility: Routing and multi-port components; preserve conditional and explicit isolation behavior.

FluxFlow.Components.Routing.Composition.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Serialization.responsibility: Serialization components with direct constructors and canonical ports.

FluxFlow.Components.Serialization.Compos.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Sessions.responsibility: Session state and correlated operations with explicit lifetime.

FluxFlow.Components.Sessions.Composition.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Sources.responsibility: Source components that start only after graph validation and linking.

FluxFlow.Components.Sources.Composition.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.State.responsibility: Stateful components with explicit serial/concurrent policy, not records for runtime state.

FluxFlow.Components.State.Composition.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Storage.responsibility: Feature-specific storage operations; retain provider contracts and durability distinctions.

FluxFlow.Components.Storage.Composition.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Storage.FileSystem.responsibility: Existing file-backed storage provider and recovery behavior.

FluxFlow.Components.Storage.SqlFile.responsibility: Existing embedded database provider; no schema rewrite by inference.

FluxFlow.Components.Timers.responsibility: Timer sources with deterministic startup, cancellation and drain.

FluxFlow.Components.Timers.Composition.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Components.Validation.responsibility: Validation components and canonical error routing.

FluxFlow.Components.Validation.Compositi.responsibility: Optional local document bindings; structural metadata without an editor dependency.

FluxFlow.Engine.DurableInput.responsibility: Optional durable ingress and acknowledgment boundaries over Core ports.

FluxFlow.Engine.DurableInput.SqlFile.responsibility: Existing durable-ingress embedded provider and restart recovery.

FluxFlow.Engine.DurableInput.TSql.responsibility: Existing durable-ingress server provider; licensed integration remains separately gated.

FluxFlow.Engine.DurableOutput.responsibility: Optional durable egress, settlement and retry over Core ports.

FluxFlow.Engine.DurableOutput.SqlFile.responsibility: Existing durable-egress embedded provider and restart recovery.

FluxFlow.Engine.DurableOutput.TSql.responsibility: Existing durable-egress server provider; licensed integration remains separately gated.

FluxFlow.Engine.HealthChecks.responsibility: Optional host health projection of runtime state; preserve current health semantics.

FluxFlow.Components.Serialization.Design.responsibility: Optional serialization presentation projected from registered structural descriptors, without activation.

FluxFlow.Components.Mqtt.Designer.responsibility: Optional messaging presentation and diagnostic event descriptions projected from registered structural descriptors, without activation.

FluxFlow.Components.Http.Designer.responsibility: Optional http presentation projected from structural descriptors without activation.

FluxFlow.Components.Mapping.Designer.responsibility: Optional mapping presentation projected from structural descriptors without activation.

FluxFlow.Components.Validation.Designer.responsibility: Optional validation presentation projected from structural descriptors without activation.

FluxFlow.Components.Routing.Designer.responsibility: Optional routing presentation projected from structural descriptors without activating nodes or selectors.
